title: W3B Glass Tiles
tagline: W3B Glass Tiles is a browser based user interface for playing in the Web3 space.
description:
The machines we had back in-the-day did the job, however, the user experience was very much command-line driven. 

Fast forward to today, the revolution in technology has brought us handheld devices with amazing user interfaces.  

However, the fast-paced Web3 and Crypto space have kinda taken us a few steps back (as far as user interface and overall experience are concerned).  

This project is all about improving the user experience, I call it Web3 Glass Tiles, a User interface for Web 3.
how_its_made: This is a hackathon, and what I did was hack, a bunch... I used several open-source packages for the user interface, and several more for interfacing with blockchains and various API's.  Visually speaking, I overlaid tons of iframes to accomplish a user interface with drag-and-drop functionality.
